messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: spike in container restarts in eu-west serving pool (eu-pool-prod-4). symptom: GPU OOMs during prefill phase. paging oncall.

Dana (oncall): paging the runtime team. seeing repeated pod restarts and GPUs at 98% memory for prolonged periods.

Lina (sre): Observed node eu-gpu-12 flapping (kubelet restarting pods). Crash logs show GPU memory growth then SIGKILL. Network and disk I/O nominal.

Ravi (runtime): Pasted runtime log excerpt from failing pod:

```
W Runtime: prefill_alloc: attempting 4.1GiB allocation for KV cache
E cuda: CUDART_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: out of memory
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "runtime/prefill_worker.py", line 421, in handle_prefill
    kv_cache.grow(request_tokens)
RuntimeError: cudaOutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate device memory
PodExitCode: 137
```

Dana (oncall): Looks like one customer job is repeatedly sending extremely long contexts (200k tokens) and we have continuous batching turned on which accumulates KV cache across batch. That pushes containers over the limit.

Lina (sre): Impact estimate: ~18% 5xxs to the longcontext model in eu region in last 10m. A support ticket came in from customer ACME-42 mentioning repeated errors and slow responses.

Ravi (runtime): Suggested mitigations (parallel ops):
- deploy ingress rule to reject prefills > 50000 tokens with 429 (quick fix)
- enable runtime per-pod KV eviction: `kv_eviction_policy=aging` so large prefills are trimmed progressively
- mark heavy customer for routing to a dedicated low-memory-safe variant: `longcontext-lite`
- temporarily disable continuous batching on longcontext model to avoid aggregate growth
- cordon and rotate the worst nodes after draining active pods slowly

Ops-Bot: Command queued: `kubectl cordon eu-gpu-12` (initiated by Lina). Node cordoned.

Dana (oncall): Applying quick ingress block for huge prefills now. Command to control plane:

```
curl -X POST https://control.internal/ingress/rules \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP" \ 
  -d '{"match":{"prefill_tokens_gt":50000},"action":"reject","status":429,"message":"prefill too large; contact support"}'
```

Ravi (runtime): Flipping `continuous_batching=false` for model `longcontext-v3` via runtime flags. Also toggling `kv_eviction_policy=aging` and `max_prefill_tokens=16384`.

Support-Liaison: Notifying affected customers (ACME-42, BetaCorp, DataLabs) that we're investigating and may route their jobs temporarily. Draft message posted to internal support thread.

Lina (sre): After these changes: pod restarts dropped significantly. We still see high memory on eu-gpu-13 but no crashes for 12 minutes. Error rate for the model dropped from 18% -> 3% in 8 minutes.

Ravi (runtime): I ran a canary request that used a 120k token prefill; ingress rejected it with 429 as intended. I then retried a 50k token prefill and it was trimmed to 16k and completed. No OOM.

Dana (oncall): Created incident INF-2026-473; priority P1. Linking logs and actions. Pager remains open while we rotate nodes and monitor for 30m.

Ops-Bot: Node drain job scheduled: `eu-rotate-13` and `eu-rotate-12`. Pods draining with graceful period 120s.

Lina (sre): Follow-up mitigations to implement post-stabilization:
- add per-customer prefill quota and burst limits in control plane
- instrument per-pod metric `prefill_kv_bytes` and alert at 70% of GPU memory
- add runtime support for size-aware KV eviction (not just age-based)
- harden CI with a long-prefill soak test (100k tokens)

Ravi (runtime): Ops note: we should also make continuous batching opt-in per-route and add a safety cap on aggregate prefill bytes per-batch. I'll open a PR.

Support-Liaison: I updated customers: ACME-42 routed to `longcontext-lite` while we harden caps; BetaCorp opted to reduce prefill size on their side.

Dana (oncall): Handoff: Lina will lead rotation + monitoring for next 6 hours. I'll update the incident timeline and close pager if stable for 30m. Marco is out; thanks for the quick ops.

IncidentBot: Incident INF-2026-473 created. https://incidents.internal/INF-2026-473

Ravi (runtime): Quick housekeeping: adding a short-lived runtime metric `prefill_requests_by_customer` to detect noisy neighbors sooner.

Lina (sre): After 30m observation: pool stable, no new OOM restarts. Downgrading priority to P2. Creating postmortem draft and assigning action owners.

Dana (oncall): Closing active pager at 18:40 UTC; leaving channel open for postmortem comments.
